text:
sam-peopleops: Heads-up 4 Jonah (current SWE intern) conversion. Manager requesting L3 base above midpoint, one-time sign-on, and prorated RSUs. Wants benefits active on day 1. Need routing.

rita-recruit: Candidate verbally accepted; wants written offer this week.

omar-mgr: Request: Base $138k, sign-on $11k (8%), RSU 1,000 prorated for year1. Start 2026-09-01. Prefer 6-month clawback.

sam-peopleops: Please paste manager justification + headcount code. We'll prepare exception packet.

omar-mgr: Justification: "owns deployment automation; immediate impact to roadmap; competitor interest; hard to backfill quickly." Headcount: ENG-2026-09-DEPLOY.

finance-ops: Budget check: ~8% over midpoint. Mark as hiring premium. Approve to committee if packet complete.

payroll-bot: To enable benefits on 9/1 we need signed offer + HRIS entry by COB Fri. Equity proration needs equity-team input.

legal-bot: 6-month clawback generally enforceable in WA; include explicit repayment terms and fallback to 12 months for CA hires.

talent-ops: Routing path: recruiting lead -> finance -> people-ops exceptions committee -> legal. Starting routing now. Will update thread after committee. :thumbsup:
